Title: Radiant Glow Vitamin C Serum
Body (HTML):
15% L-ascorbic acid held at pH 3.2, buffered with ferulic acid and vitamin E so it stays stable in the bottle rather than oxidising in a fortnight. Brightens uneven tone and softens the look of post-acne marks.

Apply four drops to clean dry skin each morning, before moisturiser and sunscreen. Start every other day if you have not used a vitamin C before.

Key actives: 15% L-ascorbic acid, 1% vitamin E, 0.5% ferulic acid.
SEO Title: Vitamin C Serum with 15% L-Ascorbic Acid
SEO Description: A stable 15% vitamin C serum for uneven tone and post-acne marks. Made in small batches and dated on the box.

Title: Midnight Retinol Renewal Serum
Body (HTML):
0.3% encapsulated retinol released slowly through the night, cushioned with squalane and bisabolol so the adjustment period is shorter than most. Targets fine lines and rough texture.

Two drops at night, three nights a week to begin, building to nightly as your skin tolerates it. Always follow with sunscreen the next morning. Not for use during pregnancy.

Key actives: 0.3% encapsulated retinol, 2% squalane, 0.5% bisabolol.
SEO Description: A gentle 0.3% encapsulated retinol serum for fine lines and texture, cushioned with squalane.

Title: Sage & Aloe Gentle Cleanser
Body (HTML):
A low-foam gel cleanser built around cold-pressed aloe and sage extract. No sulphates, no fragrance, and a pH of 5.5, so it lifts sunscreen and grime without leaving skin tight.

Massage a coin-sized amount over damp skin for thirty seconds, then rinse. Safe to use morning and night, and safe over active retinol use.

Key ingredients: cold-pressed aloe barbadensis, 2% sage leaf extract, glycerin.
SEO Description: A sulphate-free pH 5.5 gel cleanser with cold-pressed aloe. Formulated for sensitive and reactive skin.

Title: Clay & Charcoal Deep Cleanse
Body (HTML):
Kaolin and activated charcoal draw out the week's build-up without stripping. Willow bark provides a mild natural salicylate for congested areas around the nose and chin.

Use twice a week in place of your usual evening cleanser. Leave on for two minutes if you want it to work as a mask, then rinse warm.

Key ingredients: kaolin clay, activated charcoal, 1% willow bark extract.
SEO Description: A twice-weekly kaolin and charcoal cleanser with willow bark, for congestion and build-up.

Title: Olive Leaf Daily Moisturiser
Body (HTML):
A light gel-cream that disappears under sunscreen and makeup. Olive leaf extract and 5% niacinamide calm redness while a ceramide trio rebuilds the barrier over a few weeks of use.

Apply morning and night after serum. Roughly a pea for the whole face.

Key actives: 5% niacinamide, ceramide NP, olive leaf extract, glycerin.
SEO Title: Olive Leaf Daily Moisturiser with Niacinamide
SEO Description: A lightweight gel-cream with 5% niacinamide and ceramides, for daily barrier support.

Title: Overnight Ceramide Recovery Cream
Body (HTML):
The heavier counterpart to the daily moisturiser. A richer occlusive layer of shea, squalane and a five-ceramide complex that works while you sleep. Use it through winter, after a retinol night, or any time the barrier is complaining.

Apply as the last step at night. A little goes further than it looks.

Key ingredients: five-ceramide complex, shea butter, squalane, cholesterol.
SEO Description: A rich night cream with a five-ceramide complex, shea and squalane, for a compromised barrier.

Title: Botanic Tint Lip Balm
Body (HTML):
A sheer wash of colour on a castor and candelilla base, so it wears like a balm rather than sitting on top of the lip. Four shades built from mineral pigment, none of them frosted.

Wears about four hours. Reapply as often as you like — there is nothing drying in it.

Key ingredients: castor seed oil, candelilla wax, shea butter, mineral pigment.
SEO Description: A sheer tinted lip balm on a castor and candelilla base, in four unfrosted shades.

Title: Velvet Matte Lip Oil
Body (HTML):
An oil that dries down matte, which should not be possible and mostly is not. Jojoba and rosehip carry the pigment; the finish sets in about ninety seconds and does not transfer.

Apply to bare lips with the doe-foot applicator. Build a second layer for full opacity.

Key ingredients: jojoba oil, rosehip seed oil, vitamin E, mineral pigment.
SEO Description: A nourishing lip oil with a transfer-resistant matte finish, in three shades.

Title: Rosemary & Argan Hair Growth Oil
Body (HTML):
A scalp oil, not a hair oil — the difference matters. Rosemary leaf extract at a dose that has actually been studied, carried in cold-pressed argan and grapeseed so it rinses out cleanly.

Part the hair and apply directly to the scalp twice a week. Leave for at least an hour, overnight if you can, then shampoo out. Give it twelve weeks before you judge it.

Key ingredients: rosemary leaf extract, cold-pressed argan oil, grapeseed oil, castor oil.
SEO Description: A twice-weekly rosemary and argan scalp oil for thinning and hair fall. Rinses out clean.

Title: Amla Repair Overnight Hair Mask
Body (HTML):
Amla and hydrolysed rice protein for hair that has been coloured, straightened, or otherwise put through it. Heavy enough to stay put overnight, light enough to wash out in one shampoo.

Apply to damp mid-lengths and ends, avoiding the scalp. Plait it, sleep on a towel, rinse in the morning. Once a week.

Key ingredients: amla fruit extract, hydrolysed rice protein, coconut oil, panthenol.
SEO Description: A weekly overnight mask with amla and rice protein, for coloured and heat-damaged hair.
